title: Washlib
description: Find car wash centers in France, compare prices, check live availability, and look up a booking.
summary: Find car wash centers in France, compare prices, check live availability, and look up a booking.
offersHint: Find car wash centers in France, compare prices, check live availability, and look up a booking. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://washlib.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_available_slots
toolsPreview.description: Find open car-wash time slots near a location on a given day. Returns centers with their available slots and busyness level.

toolsPreview.name: find_centers
toolsPreview.description: List active car-wash centers within radiusKm of a latitude/longitude, nearest first.

toolsPreview.name: get_services
toolsPreview.description: List the services a center offers with a starting price each. centerId is the numeric id from find_centers.

toolsPreview.name: recommend_wash
toolsPreview.description: Recommend a wash formula for a vehicle given how dirty it is and the season. Pure guidance, no booking.

toolsPreview.name: get_booking
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a booking the caller owns. Requires a Firebase phone-OTP token (Authorization: Bearer <idToken>); the booking is only returned when its phone number matches the verified caller.
